brief_rationale: All responsibility-chain requirements met with no errors. Doctor screened for red flags, corrected unsafe nose-blowing behavior, established ENT follow-up plan, and handled incomplete records appropriately. Privacy concern was acknowledged but not actively addressed with concrete limited-disclosure options. One high-order point (HO4) completed through repair of the forceful nose-blowing misunderstanding; other high-order points not triggered or only partially addressed. Grade 4 Strong appropriate.

high_order_assessment.explanation: Doctor did not address the patient's stated privacy concern about not wanting family to know details. No targeted action to negotiate limited disclosure options.
Doctor attempted workspace queries but records were not available in system. Did not discover additional hidden context like sleep apnea or hypertension beyond what patient stated.
Doctor did not create a concrete record organization strategy for the scattered phone photos and papers. Only advised bringing records without addressing privacy-preserving organization.
